Agent 02/35 — speed-scrub steering feedback audit. The new digital steering limit increases as vehicle speed falls. Test whether sustained keyboard cornering can create a positive feedback loop: steering scrubs speed, lower speed unlocks more steering, which scrubs more speed and tightens abruptly. Focus 25–90 km/h and the 6–12 m/s crossover. Propose hysteresis/rate shaping only if measured behavior warrants it. Preserve analog full rack, genuine countersteer authority, tire model, and no hidden stability forces. Require mirrored deterministic tests plus digital-steering, keyboard-cornering, cornering, strict M5 validation and build.
